name: firebase-tauri-workspace
description: Tauri 2 plugins for Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Messaging: ports of @capacitor-firebase/analytics, crashlytics and messaging

scripts.build: npm run build -w tauri-plugin-firebase-analytics-api -w tauri-plugin-firebase-crashlytics-api -w tauri-plugin-firebase-messaging-api
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
